story.title: From Humble Beginnings to Medical Excellence
story.p1: Founded in 1988 by Dr. Eleanor Rigby with a small team of dedicated nurses, Everleaf Medical Center started with a simple mission: to provide accessible, high-quality healthcare to the local community.
story.p2: Today, we have grown into a 500-bed multi-specialty quaternary care hospital. Despite our expansion, our core philosophy remains unchanged—putting the patient first. We are driven by the belief that healthcare is not just about treating diseases, but about healing people.

preventive-cardiology.title: 5 Essential Tips for Preventive Heart Health
preventive-cardiology.excerpt: Heart disease remains the leading cause of death globally, yet up to 80% of cardiovascular diseases are preventable. Learn the five evidence-based strategies our cardiologists recommend.
preventive-cardiology.seoTitle: Preventive Cardiology: 5 Essential Tips for Heart Health
preventive-cardiology.seoDescription: Expert cardiologist advice on preventing heart disease through lifestyle changes, regular screenings, and proactive care.
preventive-cardiology.author: Dr. Mark Williams
preventive-cardiology.authorBio: Dr. Williams is a dedicated cardiologist focusing on preventive heart care and minimally invasive surgical procedures. He leads our comprehensive cardiovascular wellness program.

0.text: Heart disease remains the leading cause of death globally, yet up to 80% of cardiovascular diseases are preventable through lifestyle modifications and early intervention. At EverLeaf Medical Center, our cardiology department emphasizes proactive care to help you maintain a healthy heart for life.

1.text: "The best time to start caring for your heart was 20 years ago. The second best time is now," says Dr. Mark Williams, Chief of Cardiology. Here are five evidence-based strategies to protect your cardiovascular health.

3.text: Regular health screenings are the foundation of preventive cardiology. Understanding your key health metrics enables early detection and intervention.

diabetes-management.title: New Breakthrough in Diabetes Management Using AI Technology
diabetes-management.excerpt: EverLeaf's latest clinical trial shows AI-driven diabetes management can reduce A1C levels by 2.5% and increase time-in-range from 55% to 78%.
diabetes-management.author: Dr. Mark Williams
diabetes-management.authorBio: Dr. Williams is also a leading researcher in the field of endocrinology, exploring the intersections between heart health and metabolic disorders like diabetes.

immune-system.title: 5 Superfoods to Boost Your Immune System This Winter
immune-system.excerpt: As winter approaches, these five superfoods can give your immune system the vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants it needs to stay strong.
immune-system.author: Dr. Emily Rodriguez
immune-system.authorBio: Dr. Rodriguez treats hormonal disorders including diabetes, thyroid conditions, and metabolic syndrome. She is passionate about functional nutrition and its role in immune health.

pediatric-wing.title: EverLeaf Opens New Pediatric Wing in West Wing
pediatric-wing.excerpt: EverLeaf Medical Center's new Pediatric Wing features 50 private rooms, a dedicated pediatric emergency department, and specialized play therapy zones.
pediatric-wing.author: Dr. Emily Chen
pediatric-wing.authorBio: Dr. Chen is a passionate pediatrician known for her gentle approach and expertise in early childhood development. She oversaw the design and implementation of the new pediatric wing.

anxiety-in-teens.title: Recognizing the Early Signs of Anxiety in Teenagers
anxiety-in-teens.excerpt: Anxiety disorders are increasingly common among teenagers. Identifying the symptoms early can lead to better outcomes and prevent long-term struggles.
anxiety-in-teens.author: Dr. Rachel Green
anxiety-in-teens.authorBio: Dr. Green specializes in cognitive behavioral therapy and mental health support for chronic illness patients. She works closely with families to create supportive environments for teens facing anxiety and depression.

flu-season.title: Flu Season 2025: Why the Vaccine is More Important Than Ever
flu-season.excerpt: With pandemic-era precautions relaxed, viruses are circulating more freely. Here's why getting your flu shot this season is more critical than ever.
flu-season.author: Dr. Bereket Kinfe
flu-season.authorBio: Dr. Kinfe is an expert in diagnosing and treating complex infectious diseases. He leads EverLeaf's annual community vaccination program and advises on seasonal flu prevention strategies.

senior-mobility.title: Mobility in Seniors: The Link Between Walking and Cognitive Health
senior-mobility.excerpt: A new study found that seniors who maintained a brisk walking pace were 40% less likely to develop cognitive impairment. Here's what you can do.
senior-mobility.author: Dr. Sarah Johnson
senior-mobility.authorBio: Dr. Johnson specializes in complex neurological disorders with over 15 years of experience. Her research focuses on the connection between physical mobility and cognitive health in aging adults.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Everleaf Medical Center ("we," "our," or "us"). This page contains our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. By accessing our website, booking appointments, or using our services, you agree to comply with these terms and consent to our data practices.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: By accessing this website, you accept these terms and conditions in full. Do not continue to use Everleaf Medical Center's website if you do not accept all of the terms and conditions stated on this page.

list.license: License: Unless otherwise stated, Everleaf Medical Center and/or its licensors own the intellectual property rights for all material on this website. All intellectual property rights are reserved.
list.conduct: User Conduct: You must not use this website in any way that causes, or may cause, damage to the website or impairment of the availability or accessibility of the website.
list.security: Account Security: If you create an account or book an appointment, you are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your personal information and booking details.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.subtitle: Not Medical Advice
disclaimer.content: The content provided on this website, including blog articles, service descriptions, and other materials, is for informational purposes only. It is <1>not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.</1> Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read on this website.
disclaimer.emergency: In case of a medical emergency, call 911 immediately.

protection.title: Data Protection Principles
protection.content: We adhere to the principles of data protection as set out in the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and HIPAA guidelines. Your data will be:
list: Processed lawfully, fairly, and in a transparent manner.
Collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes.
Adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary.
Kept accurate and up to date.

collection.title: Information Collection
collection.content: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you.

personal.title: Personal Data
personal.content: While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you ("Personal Data"). This may include, but is not limited to: Email address, First name and last name, Phone number, Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City.

medical.title: Medical Data
medical.content: When you book an appointment or visit our facility, we collect health information necessary for your care. This is protected under strict medical privacy laws (HIPAA/GDPR).

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.content: We may also collect information how the Service is accessed and used ("Usage Data"). This Usage Data may include information such as your computer's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

rights.title: Your Rights as a Patient
rights.content: Under data protection law, you have rights including:

access.title: Right of Access
access.content: You have the right to ask us for copies of your personal medical information.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.content: You have the right to ask us to rectify personal information you think is inaccurate.

erasure.title: Right to Erasure
erasure.content: You have the right to ask us to erase your personal information in certain circumstances.

restriction.title: Right to Restriction
restriction.content: You have the right to ask us to restrict the processing of your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our Service and hold certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

contact.title: Questions about our Privacy Policy?
contact.subtitle: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us. Our dedicated data protection officer will be happy to assist you.
